features: Adaptive coverage of section faces by multiple obstacles with conservative volume proofs
Shared budget, resumable jobs and camera-aware cache invalidation
Actual Create window panes and section reason in /slopium inspect

integration.startupRetry: First full frustum run failed in foreign content registration before testing; retry passed
integration.postRuntimeChange: Pending section queue is serviced even if point table expires; included in final build

limitations: Current camera section and sections containing visible geometry cannot be removed as a whole
Pending or unproven coverage remains visible; no guaranteed immediate hiding or FPS gain
No benchmark in user server world; small isolated scenes only
Distant Horizons LOD, entities, particles and moving virtual worlds are outside section mask scope
